applyBillDiscount: Apply bill-level discount (cart must have items)
openPayment: Open payment modal (cart must have items)
fastCash: Fast Cash — exact cash, no receipt printed
noSaleDrawer: No-sale — open cash drawer without a sale
showShortcutHelp: Show this keyboard shortcut help screen
shortcutTip: Most F-key shortcuts work even when a modal is open. Ctrl shortcuts require no modal to be active.
importFailed: Import failed. Check your file and try again.
pipeSeparatedBarcodes: Pipe-separated barcodes; a single barcode also works
booleanDefaultTrue: true or false; defaults to true
existingTaxRule: Must match an existing tax rule name
variablePriceHint: Enter a valid price, or leave blank for variable price
catalogScanDescription: Catalog scanned for shared barcodes, SKUs, exact names, and similar names with close prices. Pick which product stays live, then merge or archive the rest.
mergeConfirmSuffix: Stock will be combined and the duplicates archived.
archiveOthersSuffix: Stock on archived items is not moved.
archiveOneSuffix: It will be hidden from the POS but remains recoverable.
mergeAllConfirm: Merge all duplicate groups? Products will be archived into their kept product.
notificationsDescription: WhatsApp messages from the owner and store group, plus unknown barcodes scanned at the till.
visionModelHint: To have AI read a photo, set a vision-capable model in Settings → AI.
allCaughtUp: You're all caught up — no notifications.
photoUnavailable: This photo is no longer available — open it in WhatsApp.
photoCacheLost: Photo is no longer cached. Forward it again via WhatsApp to download it again.
whatsappReconnectPhoto: Could not load the photo. Make sure ZanPOS WhatsApp is connected and try again.
paidInDescription: Record cash added to the drawer, such as a change fund or petty cash.
paidOutDescription: Record cash removed from the drawer, such as an expense or deposit.
safeDropDescription: Transfer cash from the drawer to the safe. This reduces the expected drawer total.
cashEventPermission: Only managers and owners can record cash events.
cashGuidance: Enter what the customer gave you. Change is calculated instantly.
cardGuidance: The exact amount is ready for the card terminal.
walletGuidance: The exact amount is ready for BenefitPay or another wallet.
lockedAmountGuidance: The exact amount is locked so the sale stays balanced.
confirmCardApproval: Confirm approval on the card terminal
confirmWalletReceived: Confirm the wallet payment was received
confirmPaymentReceived: Confirm the approved payment was received
everyPaymentAmount: Enter an amount for every payment.
validDeliveryContact: Add a valid delivery contact number.
deliveryBuilding: Add the delivery building or house number.
noOrderItemsMatched: No order items matched POS products. Add them manually, then fulfil.
completeThenFulfil: Complete the sale, then mark the order fulfilled.
receiptLookupPermission: Only managers and owners can look up receipts.
refundPermission: Only managers and owners can process refunds.
activeShiftMissing: Could not find the active shift. Please contact your manager.
readyPressEnter: Ready — press Enter or tap below
invalidBahrainNumber: Enter an 8-digit Bahrain number, for example 33050666
